messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered: kv-cache-evictions-high (sev2) • 3 pages in 12m. Impact: increased tail latency for short-gen requests, error rate ~1.8% for customer tier 'Dedicated'. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kv-eviction

Sylvie Chen: I'm on it, primary is me for this shift. Starting triage.

Raja Patel: i'm secondary, oncall phone +1-555-0102. if you need infra scaling ping me.

Eli Torres: saw a spike on the dashboard — eviction rate correlates with hot-prefix churn after the midnight rollout

Sylvie Chen: Confirmed. evictions/sec jumped from 3 -> 38 around 20:03 UTC. Serving pods memory pressure + OOM kills on a subset.

Marisol Vega: customer-reports: two customers in Dedicated saw 429s and slow completions. CS alerted them that we're investigating.

Sylvie Chen: Quick plan: 1) enable temporary eviction backoff (per-runbook) 2) scale pool 'kv-serve-dedicated' +2 replicas 3) roll back recent tokenizer hotfix to stop churn if correlated

Raja Patel: on step 2. scaling now.

oncall-bot: Command executed by Raja Patel: `rb-infra scale --pool kv-serve-dedicated --delta +2 --reason "eviction spike"`

incidents-bot: Action logged: scale request acknowledged. Monitoring for 3m.

Eli Torres: while scaling, toggling prefix-cache retention windows to 30s to reduce churn (will increase token cost briefly)

Sylvie Chen: doing retention toggle. snippet:
```
config.cache.prefix_retention = 30s
service restart kv-processor
```

Marisol Vega: notifying customers: "We are mitigating a cache eviction-related latency issue; next update in 30m." Sent to Priority customers A & B.

Raja Patel: scaled +2 replicas are up (2/2 containers healthy). watching metrics — evictions/sec dropping from 38 -> 9.

incidents-bot: Automated regression detector: latency 95p decreased from 720ms -> 210ms after scale and retention changes.

Sylvie Chen: Good. Remaining risk: token-cost bump and potential ripple on other pools. Need an action item to review midnight rollout that introduced the tokenizer guard config.

Eli Torres: noted. I'll open a ticket with link to the rollout and diff; please assign to `model-onboard-squad`.

Sylvie Chen: Next steps before handoff: - Keep primary on watch for next 45m - If evictions/sec < 5 and error-rate < 0.5% move to monitor-only - Create postmortem if we see >1.5% errors persist after 1h

Raja Patel: coverage gap note: Marisol is offline 21:30-22:15 UTC (customer sync). if pager escalates while she's out, assume primary+eli handle customer comms.

Marisol Vega: ack. I'll leave my OOO in the thread and CC CS leads in customer updates.

oncall-bot: Scheduled check-in reminder set for 20:50 UTC (30m).

Sylvie Chen: handoff to next shift (Eli primary, Raja secondary) at 21:00 UTC unless things regress. I'll write short runbook pointers:
- Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kv-eviction
- Quick commands: `rb-infra scale`, `rb-deploy rollback --since 20:00UTC`, cache retention toggle above
- Dashboards: /dashboards/kv-evictions, /dashboards/latency-95p

Eli Torres: got it. I'll monitor and update this thread if anything changes.

Sylvie Chen: thanks team. tagging follow-ups: @oncall-bot create-incident-ticket with summary "eviction spike during tokenizer rollout" and link to graphs.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-312 created: https://redwood-issues/INC-2026-312

Marisol Vega: I'll do a customer follow-up once we're in monitor-only and include mitigation details.

Sylvie Chen: last check: evictions/sec steady ~4, error-rate 0.4%, latency 95p 230ms. moving to monitor-only. handing off in 10.

Eli Torres: confirmed received. primary/secondary switch noted. thanks.

Sylvie Chen: end of thread — final status: mitigated->monitoring. follow-ups: postmortem if errors rebound, rollout rollback review by model-onboard-squad.
